```{r}
# input loading 
read_inputs <- function(counts_path, meta_path) {
  cts_df  <- read.csv(counts_path, check.names = FALSE)
  meta_df <- read.csv(meta_path, check.names = FALSE)

  cts <- cts_df %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("feature") %>%
    as.matrix()

  meta <- meta_df %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("sample")

  cts <- cts[, rownames(meta), drop = FALSE]

  meta$condition <- factor(meta$condition, levels = c("R", "X"))
  meta$replicate <- factor(meta$replicate)
  meta$virus     <- factor(meta$virus)

  list(cts = cts, meta = meta)
}

inp <- read_inputs(COUNTS_PATH, META_PATH)
cts <- inp$cts
meta <- inp$meta

table(meta$virus, meta$condition)
table(meta$virus, meta$replicate, meta$condition)
```

```{r}
# DESeq2 helpers
restrict_counts_to_window <- function(cts_mat, pos_min, pos_max) {
  pos <- as.integer(sub("_.*$", "", rownames(cts_mat)))
  keep <- pos >= pos_min & pos <= pos_max
  cts_mat[keep, , drop = FALSE]
}

run_deseq_for_virus <- function(virus_name, cts, meta, pos_min, pos_max, min_total_counts = 10) {
  m <- meta[meta$virus == virus_name, , drop = FALSE]
  c <- cts[, rownames(m), drop = FALSE]

  c <- restrict_counts_to_window(c, pos_min, pos_max)
  c <- c[rowSums(c) >= min_total_counts, , drop = FALSE]

  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = round(c),
    colData   = m,
    design    = ~ replicate + condition
  )

  dds <- DESeq(dds)
  res <- results(dds, contrast = c("condition", "X", "R"))

  res_df <- as.data.frame(res)
  res_df$feature <- rownames(res_df)

  res_df %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    tidyr::separate(feature, into = c("pos", "change"), sep = "_", remove = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(
      pos = as.integer(pos),
      neglog10padj = -log10(padj),
      neglog10padj = ifelse(is.finite(neglog10padj), neglog10padj, NA_real_),
      neglog10padj_cap = pmin(neglog10padj, 10)
    ) %>%
    select(
      feature, pos, change,
      baseMean, log2FoldChange, lfcSE, stat, pvalue, padj,
      neglog10padj, neglog10padj_cap
    )
}

save_tsv <- function(df, path) readr::write_tsv(df, path)
```


```{r}
# Bubble plot styling
plot_bubble_circles <- function(res_df, title, out_pdf) {
  p <- ggplot(res_df, aes(x = pos, y = log2FoldChange)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(
      aes(size = neglog10padj_cap, color = change),
      shape = 16,
      alpha = 0.75
    ) +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "-log10(padj) (cap=10)") +
    labs(title = title, x = "Position", y = "log2FoldChange (X/R)", color = "Mutation") +
    theme_classic()

  ggsave(out_pdf, p, width = 12, height = 4)
  p
}

p_zikv_bubble <- plot_bubble_circles(
  zikv_res,
  title = "ZIKV: X vs R (pos 25–107)",
  out_pdf = file.path(OUTDIR, "ZIKV_bubbleplot_circles.pdf")
)

  title = "DENV: X vs R (pos 24–104)",

)
```

```{r}
# Structure annotation: paired vs unpaired
make_paired_df <- function(pos_start, seq_rna, dotbracket) {
  stopifnot(nchar(seq_rna) == nchar(dotbracket))
  tibble(
    pos = pos_start:(pos_start + nchar(seq_rna) - 1),
    paired = strsplit(dotbracket, "")[[1]] %in% c("(", ")")
  )
}

zikv_paired_df <- make_paired_df(STRUCT$ZIKV$pos_start, STRUCT$ZIKV$seq, STRUCT$ZIKV$db)
denv_paired_df <- make_paired_df(STRUCT$DENV$pos_start, STRUCT$DENV$seq, STRUCT$DENV$db)

zikv_annot <- zikv_res %>% left_join(zikv_paired_df, by = "pos")
denv_annot <- denv_res %>% left_join(denv_paired_df, by = "pos")

zikv_summary <- zikv_annot %>% group_by(paired) %>%
  summarize(median_lfc = median(log2FoldChange, na.rm=TRUE), n=n(), .groups="drop")

denv_summary <- denv_annot %>% group_by(paired) %>%
  summarize(median_lfc = median(log2FoldChange, na.rm=TRUE), n=n(), .groups="drop")

zikv_summary
denv_summary

zikv_w <- wilcox.test(log2FoldChange ~ paired, data = zikv_annot)
denv_w <- wilcox.test(log2FoldChange ~ paired, data = denv_annot)

zikv_w
denv_w

save_tsv(zikv_annot, file.path(OUTDIR, "ZIKV_annot_paired.tsv"))
save_tsv(denv_annot, file.path(OUTDIR, "DENV_annot_paired.tsv"))

save_tsv(zikv_summary, file.path(OUTDIR, "ZIKV_paired_medians.tsv"))
save_tsv(denv_summary, file.path(OUTDIR, "DENV_paired_medians.tsv"))

save_tsv(tibble(virus="ZIKV", W=unname(zikv_w$statistic), p_value=zikv_w$p.value),
         file.path(OUTDIR, "ZIKV_paired_wilcox.tsv"))
save_tsv(tibble(virus="DENV", W=unname(denv_w$statistic), p_value=denv_w$p.value),
         file.path(OUTDIR, "DENV_paired_wilcox.tsv"))
```

```{r}
plot_paired_box <- function(df, title, out_pdf) {
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = paired, y = log2FoldChange)) +
```

```{r}
# per-position sensitivity map
position_summary <- function(res_df) {
  res_df %>%
    group_by(pos) %>%
    summarize(
      median_lfc = median(log2FoldChange, na.rm = TRUE),
      min_lfc = min(log2FoldChange, na.rm = TRUE),
      max_lfc = max(log2FoldChange, na.rm = TRUE),
      n = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

zikv_pos <- position_summary(zikv_res) %>% left_join(zikv_paired_df, by="pos")
denv_pos <- position_summary(denv_res) %>% left_join(denv_paired_df, by="pos")

plot_pos_sensitivity <- function(df, title, out_pdf) {
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = pos, y = median_lfc)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(aes(alpha = paired), shape = 16) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(title = title, x = "Position", y = "Median log2FC (X/R)")
  ggsave(out_pdf, p, width = 10, height = 3.5)
  p
}

plot_pos_sensitivity(zikv_pos, "ZIKV: per-position median effect", file.path(OUTDIR, "ZIKV_position_sensitivity.pdf"))
plot_pos_sensitivity(denv_pos, "DENV: per-position median effect", file.path(OUTDIR, "DENV_position_sensitivity.pdf"))

save_tsv(zikv_pos, file.path(OUTDIR, "ZIKV_position_sensitivity.tsv"))
save_tsv(denv_pos, file.path(OUTDIR, "DENV_position_sensitivity.tsv"))
```

# Dot bracket overlay 
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

# Optional but very convenient for stacking plots
# If not installed: install.packages("patchwork")
library(patchwork)

make_struct_track_df <- function(pos_start, seq_rna, dotbracket) {
  stopifnot(nchar(seq_rna) == nchar(dotbracket))

  tibble(
    pos = pos_start:(pos_start + nchar(seq_rna) - 1),
    base = strsplit(seq_rna, "")[[1]],
    db   = strsplit(dotbracket, "")[[1]]
  )
}

plot_structure_track <- function(track_df, title = NULL, label_every = 5) {
  # Position labels only at chosen interval
  labs_df <- track_df %>%
    mutate(show = (pos - min(pos)) %% label_every == 0)

  ggplot() +
    # dot-bracket row
    geom_text(
      data = track_df,
      aes(x = pos, y = 0, label = db),
      size = 3
    ) +
    # sequence row
    geom_text(
      data = track_df,
      aes(x = pos, y = -1, label = base),
      size = 3
    ) +
    # position labels row (sparser)
    geom_text(
      data = labs_df %>% filter(show),
      aes(x = pos, y = 1, label = pos),
      size = 2.8
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(1, 0, -1), labels = c("pos", "db", "seq")) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      axis.line.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(5.5, 5.5, 5.5, 5.5),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 11)
    )
}

position_summary <- function(res_df) {
  res_df %>%
    group_by(pos) %>%
    summarize(
      median_lfc = median(log2FoldChange, na.rm = TRUE),
      n = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

plot_pos_sensitivity <- function(pos_df, paired_df = NULL, title = NULL) {
  df <- pos_df
  if (!is.null(paired_df)) df <- df %>% left_join(paired_df, by = "pos")

  ggplot(df, aes(x = pos, y = median_lfc)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(aes(alpha = paired), shape = 16) +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 1, `FALSE` = 0.35), na.value = 0.6, guide = "none") +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(title = title, x = "Position", y = "Median log2FC (X/R)")
}

# Build track dataframes from STRUCT
denv_track <- make_struct_track_df(STRUCT$DENV$pos_start, STRUCT$DENV$seq, STRUCT$DENV$db)
zikv_track <- make_struct_track_df(STRUCT$ZIKV$pos_start, STRUCT$ZIKV$seq, STRUCT$ZIKV$db)

# Build paired/unpaired lookup from dot-bracket
denv_paired <- denv_track %>% transmute(pos, paired = db %in% c("(", ")"))
zikv_paired <- zikv_track %>% transmute(pos, paired = db %in% c("(", ")"))

# Build per-position summaries from DESeq2 results already in memory
denv_pos <- position_summary(denv_res)
zikv_pos <- position_summary(zikv_res)

# Make stacked plots: effect on top, structure underneath
p_denv <- plot_pos_sensitivity(denv_pos, denv_paired, title = "DENV: per-position effect with structure track") /
  plot_structure_track(denv_track, title = NULL, label_every = 5) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(2.2, 1))

p_zikv <- plot_pos_sensitivity(zikv_pos, zikv_paired, title = "ZIKV: per-position effect with structure track") /
  plot_structure_track(zikv_track, title = NULL, label_every = 5) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(2.2, 1))

p_denv
p_zikv

# Save to PDF
ggsave(file.path(OUTDIR, "DENV_structure_overlay.pdf"), p_denv, width = 12, height = 5)
ggsave(file.path(OUTDIR, "ZIKV_structure_overlay.pdf"), p_zikv, width = 12, height = 5)
```
# New workflow with minimal element 
### prevent sequencing/alignment artifacts due to the 5' extremity of the Xrn1-treated sample. (The high dot is probably the stop site!)
### due to Xrn1 stop site, mutations near the dominant 5′ end become artificially enriched in X samples.Avoid by starting at minimal element, paste the annotated stop site. 
### Try end-to-end alignment instead of local, but have to remove the 5' Nmer added by ligation. 
```{r}
MIN_WINDOWS <- list(
  DENV = c(28, 104),  # minimal element starts at 28
  ZIKV = c(29, 107)   # minimal element starts at 29
)

# Slice the structure strings to match the minimal window
slice_struct <- function(pos_start_full, seq_full, db_full, new_start, new_end) {
  full_end <- pos_start_full + nchar(seq_full) - 1
  stopifnot(new_start >= pos_start_full, new_end <= full_end)

  i1 <- new_start - pos_start_full + 1
  i2 <- new_end   - pos_start_full + 1

  list(
    pos_start = new_start,
    seq = substr(seq_full, i1, i2),
    db  = substr(db_full,  i1, i2)
  )
}

STRUCT_MIN <- list(
  DENV = slice_struct(STRUCT$DENV$pos_start, STRUCT$DENV$seq, STRUCT$DENV$db,
                      new_start = MIN_WINDOWS$DENV[1], new_end = MIN_WINDOWS$DENV[2]),
  ZIKV = slice_struct(STRUCT$ZIKV$pos_start, STRUCT$ZIKV$seq, STRUCT$ZIKV$db,
                      new_start = MIN_WINDOWS$ZIKV[1], new_end = MIN_WINDOWS$ZIKV[2])
)

# Re-run DESeq2 restricted to minimal windows (keeps replicate blocking)
zikv_res_min <- run_deseq_for_virus(
  virus_name = "ZIKV",
  cts = cts,
  meta = meta,
  pos_min = MIN_WINDOWS$ZIKV[1],
  pos_max = MIN_WINDOWS$ZIKV[2],
  min_total_counts = 10
)

denv_res_min <- run_deseq_for_virus(
  virus_name = "DENV",
  cts = cts,
  meta = meta,
  pos_min = MIN_WINDOWS$DENV[1],
  pos_max = MIN_WINDOWS$DENV[2],
  min_total_counts = 10
)

save_tsv(zikv_res_min, file.path(OUTDIR, "ZIKV_DESeq2_results_minimal.tsv"))
save_tsv(denv_res_min, file.path(OUTDIR, "DENV_DESeq2_results_minimal.tsv"))
```

```{r}
# version of plot with base-specific colors: 

plot_bubble_circles <- function(res_df, title, out_pdf) {

  df <- res_df %>%
    mutate(
      mutant_base = sub(".*>", "", change),
      mutant_base = gsub("T", "U", mutant_base)  # RNA alphabet
    )

  base_colors <- c(
    A = "#2ca25f",   # green
    U = "#de2d26",   # red
    C = "#fdae6b",   # orange
    G = "#3182bd"    # blue
  )

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = pos, y = log2FoldChange)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    geom_point(
      aes(
        size = neglog10padj_cap,
        fill = mutant_base
      ),
      shape = 21,
      color = "black",
      stroke = 0.2,
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
    values = base_colors,
    breaks = c("A","U","C","G"),
    name = "Mutant base"
     ) +
    scale_size_continuous(
      name = "-log10(padj)",
      range = c(1.5, 6)
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "Position",
      y = "log2FoldChange (X/R)"
    ) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12)
    )

  ggsave(out_pdf, p, width = 12, height = 4)
  p
}
```

# New bubble plot with the structure overlay: 
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# Bubble plot (mutant base colors) – returns a ggplot object, does not save by itself
plot_bubble_mutbase <- function(res_df, title = NULL) {
  df <- res_df %>%
    mutate(
      mutant_base = sub(".*>", "", change),
      mutant_base = gsub("T", "U", mutant_base)
    )

  base_colors <- c(
    A = "#2ca25f",  # green
    U = "#de2d26",  # red
    C = "#fdae6b",  # orange
    G = "#3182bd"   # blue
  )

  ggplot(df, aes(x = pos, y = log2FoldChange)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    geom_point(
      aes(size = neglog10padj_cap, fill = mutant_base),
      shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 0.2, alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = base_colors, breaks = c("A","U","C","G"), name = "Mutant base") +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "-log10(padj)", range = c(1.5, 6)) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = "log2FoldChange (X/R)") +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12)
    )
}

# Build a structure track dataframe for a window
make_struct_track_df <- function(pos_start, seq_rna, dotbracket) {
  stopifnot(nchar(seq_rna) == nchar(dotbracket))
  tibble(
    pos = pos_start:(pos_start + nchar(seq_rna) - 1),
    base = strsplit(seq_rna, "")[[1]],
    db   = strsplit(dotbracket, "")[[1]]
  )
}

# Plot: position labels + dot-bracket + sequence aligned on x=pos
plot_structure_track <- function(track_df, label_every = 5) {
  labs_df <- track_df %>%
    mutate(show = (pos - min(pos)) %% label_every == 0)

  ggplot() +
    geom_text(data = track_df, aes(x = pos, y = 0,  label = db),   size = 3) +
    geom_text(data = track_df, aes(x = pos, y = -1, label = base), size = 3) +
    geom_text(data = labs_df %>% filter(show), aes(x = pos, y = 1, label = pos), size = 2.8) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(1, 0, -1), labels = c("pos", "db", "seq")) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(x = "Position", y = NULL) +
    theme(
      axis.line.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(5.5, 5.5, 5.5, 5.5)
    )
}

# Combine bubble + structure into one figure and save
make_bubble_with_track <- function(res_df, pos_start, seq_rna, dotbracket, title, out_pdf, label_every = 5) {
  track_df <- make_struct_track_df(pos_start, seq_rna, dotbracket)

  p1 <- plot_bubble_mutbase(res_df, title = title)
  p2 <- plot_structure_track(track_df, label_every = label_every)

  combined <- p1 / p2 + plot_layout(heights = c(2.4, 1))
  ggsave(out_pdf, combined, width = 12, height = 5)
  combined
}

# DENV minimal element stacked plot
p_denv_stack <- make_bubble_with_track(
  res_df = denv_res_min,
  pos_start = STRUCT_MIN$DENV$pos_start,
  seq_rna = STRUCT_MIN$DENV$seq,
  dotbracket = STRUCT_MIN$DENV$db,
  title = "DENV: X vs R (minimal element) with structure track",
  out_pdf = file.path(OUTDIR, "DENV_bubble_minimal_with_structure.pdf"),

)
```

# bubble plot with edits newest version
```{r}
# wider bubble + structure overlays WITH GRIDLINES

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

plot_bubble_mutbase_wide <- function(res_df, title = NULL) {

  df <- res_df %>%
    mutate(
      mutant_base = sub(".*>", "", change),
      mutant_base = gsub("T", "U", mutant_base)
    )

  base_colors <- c(
    A = "#2ca25f",  # green
    U = "#de2d26",  # red
    C = "#fdae6b",  # orange
    G = "#3182bd"   # blue
  )

  xpos <- seq(min(df$pos), max(df$pos), by = 1)

  ggplot(df, aes(x = pos, y = log2FoldChange)) +

    geom_hline(yintercept = 0,
               linetype = "dashed",
               color = "black",
               linewidth = 0.3) +

    geom_point(
      aes(size = neglog10padj_cap, fill = mutant_base),
      shape = 21,
      color = "black",
      stroke = 0.2,
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +

    scale_fill_manual(
      values = base_colors,
      breaks = c("A","U","C","G"),
      name = "Mutant base"
    ) +

    scale_size_continuous(
      name = "-log10(padj)",
      range = c(1.2, 5.5)
    ) +

    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = xpos,
      expand = expansion(add = c(1,1))
    ) +

    theme_classic() +

    labs(
      title = title,
      x = NULL,
      y = "log2FoldChange (X/R)"
    ) +

    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12),

      # gridlines
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3),
      panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey88", linewidth = 0.3),
      panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),

      panel.background = element_blank()
    )
}



make_struct_track_df_wide <- function(pos_start, seq_rna, dotbracket) {

  stopifnot(nchar(seq_rna) == nchar(dotbracket))

  tibble(
    pos = pos_start:(pos_start + nchar(seq_rna) - 1),
    base = strsplit(seq_rna, "")[[1]],
    db   = strsplit(dotbracket, "")[[1]]
  )
}



plot_structure_track_wide <- function(track_df, label_every = 5) {

  labs_df <- track_df %>%
    mutate(show = (pos - min(pos)) %% label_every == 0)

  # gridlines every nucleotide (major x grid)
  xpos_grid <- seq(min(track_df$pos), max(track_df$pos), by = 1)

  ggplot() +
    geom_text(data = track_df,
              aes(x = pos, y = 0, label = db),
              size = 3.3) +
    geom_text(data = track_df,
              aes(x = pos, y = -1, label = base),
              size = 3.3) +
    geom_text(
      data = labs_df %>% filter(show),
      aes(x = pos, y = 1, label = pos),
      size = 2.8
    ) +

    # Keep breaks at every nt to get vertical gridlines
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = xpos_grid,
      expand = expansion(add = c(1,1))
    ) +

    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = c(1,0,-1),
      labels = c("pos","db","seq")
    ) +

    theme_classic() +
    labs(x = "Position", y = NULL) +

    theme(
      axis.line.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),

      # remove axis x labels/ticks so they don't overlap
      axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),

      # gridlines match top panel
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),

      plot.margin = margin(6,6,6,6)
    )
}



make_bubble_with_track_wide <- function(res_df,
                                       pos_start,
                                       seq_rna,
                                       dotbracket,
                                       title,
                                       out_pdf,
                                       label_every = 5,
                                       width = 18,
                                       height = 5) {

  track_df <- make_struct_track_df_wide(
    pos_start,
    seq_rna,
    dotbracket
  )

  p_top <- plot_bubble_mutbase_wide(res_df, title)
  p_bot <- plot_structure_track_wide(track_df, label_every)

  combined <- p_top / p_bot +
    plot_layout(heights = c(2.4, 1))

  ggsave(out_pdf, combined, width = width, height = height)

  combined
}
```

# Read depth per mutation "feature"
```{r}
# Convert counts matrix into a tidy long format
library(tidyverse)

# counts matrix -> dataframe with feature column
cts_df <- as.data.frame(cts) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("feature")

# metadata -> dataframe with sample column
meta_df <- meta %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("sample")

# long format: mutation feature x sample
cts_long <- cts_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    -feature,
    names_to = "sample",
    values_to = "alt_depth"
  ) %>%
  left_join(meta_df, by = "sample") %>%
  mutate(
    pos = as.integer(sub("_.*", "", feature)),
    change = sub(".*_", "", feature)
  )

head(cts_long)
```


```{r}
# Distribution of read depth 
ggplot(cts_long, aes(alt_depth)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 100) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Read depth per mutation (log10 scale)",
    y = "Count",
    title = "Distribution of mutation read depth"
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(cts_long, aes(x = alt_depth)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 120) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = "Alt read depth per mutation feature (log10)",
    y = "Number of (feature × sample) observations",
    title = "Mutation feature depth distribution"
  )
```

```{r}
# Depth distribution separated by condition 
ggplot(cts_long, aes(alt_depth, fill = condition)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 80, alpha = 0.6, position = "identity") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  theme_classic()
# X axis = sequencing depth of a mutation instance
# Y axis = How many mutation×replicate observations fall into that depth bin. e.g. frequency of mutations having that depth
# far right peaks: mutations have high read depths supporting them , but are found less in XRN1-treated condition (Xrn1-treated is left-shifted)
```


```{r}
# Replicate consistency 
cts_long %>%
  group_by(feature, condition) %>%
  summarize(mean_depth = mean(alt_depth), .groups="drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(mean_depth)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 80) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title="Mean replicate depth per mutation")
```
